ancova: the template ancova

Source: R/tpl_docs.R
tfl_tpl_ancova.Rd

The table template ancova, layout summary. Its program is one call, tfl_tpl(ard, "ancova", ...); a parameter a report leaves out takes the study standard's value, else the variant's default, else the layout's.

Parameters

ParameterTierStageDefaultMaps toWhat
populationrequiredcalloutput.populationthe analysis set's id (SAF)
subsetothercallwhich subjects (R, on the analysis set's ADSL): PART == "Part 1"
datarequiredcallthe BDS dataset (ADVS, ADLB)
paramrequiredcallthe PARAMCD (SYSBP)
visitrequiredcallthe AVISIT (CYCLE 9 DAY 1)
byothercallTRT01Asettings.treatmentthe arm variable (the columns)
responseothercallCHGthe response variable
covariatesothercallBASEthe model's covariates besides the arm
whereothercallthe records kept besides the parameter and visit (R)
refothercallthe reference arm; NULL: the last arm in the code list's order

Example

plan <- tfl_tpl(ard, "ancova", population = "SAF", data = "ADVS", param = "SYSBP", visit = "CYCLE 2 DAY 1")

See also

tfl_tpl(), tfl_tpl_help(), tfl_tpl_args(), tfl_templates()

Examples

tfl_tpl_help("ancova", tier = c("required", "usual"))
#> ancova (table, layout summary; tflspec)
#> Call: tfl_tpl(ard, "ancova", ...)
#> 
#> required (4):
#>   param      | effective (layer) | what
#>   population | - (template)      | the analysis set's id (SAF)
#>   data       | - (template)      | the BDS dataset (ADVS, ADLB)
#>   param      | - (template)      | the PARAMCD (SYSBP)
#>   visit      | - (template)      | the AVISIT (CYCLE 9 DAY 1)
